# FAX v0.0.1

This is the first public research scaffold release of FAX: a differentiable JAX
codebase for Alfvén-continuum, eigenmode, fast-ion, and stellarator-design
workflows.

## What Is Included

- Installable `fax` package and CLI.
- MIT license.
- TOML-driven workflows with rich progress output.
- Analytic continuum and metric-matrix validation scaffold.
- Reduced radial global-eigenmode operator with exact finite-difference spectrum gate.
- Analytic TAE/EAE/HAE gap-center screens.
- Fast BAE/TAE/EAE large-aspect-ratio gap-map example and generated figure.
- Reduced fast-ion transit/precession resonance diagnostics.
- Optional Boozer-spectrum reader and local `booz_xform_jax` smoke path.
- Boozer harmonic reconstruction/projection, orthogonality, and straight-field-line phase gates.
- Reduced Boozer continuum matrix checks for constant-field recovery and sideband coupling.
- Boozer-Jacobian identity and Jacobian-weighted reduced continuum checks.
- Real `boozmn` geometry/Jacobian reader plus local 3-D Boozer continuum matrix.
- Real-file Boozer gates for `sqrt(g)|B|^2=G+iota I`, embedding-Jacobian shape, and finite Hermitian local 3-D continuum output.
- Global radial 3-D Boozer block eigenmode operator with radial/harmonic mode structures and residual gates.
- Metric-derived Boozer radial stiffness, Neumann radial boundary variant, and eigenfunction-weighted fast-ion drive/damping screen.
- Reduced gyro-Landau fast-ion closure API with resonant, dispersive, diamagnetic, and thermal-Landau damping coefficients plus sign/regression gates.
- Differentiable gyro-Landau closure calibration from eigenfunction-weighted growth-rate targets.
- Real-`boozmn` global radial convergence gates for angular quadrature, radial surface coarsening, boundary-condition variants, and radial-stiffness variants.
- Builder-based Boozer pipeline objective for future differentiable `vmec_jax`/`booz_xform_jax` optimization workflows.
- Public ORNL STELLGAP CTOK local-continuum and largest-local-gap comparison gates and generated figure.
- Public ORNL AE3D eigenvalue-answer parser/residual smoke gate.
- Public ORNL STELLGAP post-processing parity gate plus AE3D omega2/matrix artifact gates.
- Public ORNL AE3D global matrix frequency and mode-shape parity gate with B-weighted eigenvector correlations.
- Bounded STELLGAP CTOK executable runtime/status capture benchmark family; the current local `xstgap 99 2048` CTOK run completes and produces `alfven_spec`.
- External-code artifact dashboard example and generated README/docs figure.
- Differentiable radial-mode avoidance objective for design-screen examples.
- VMEC `wout` adapter smoke path using the Landreman-Paul QA low-resolution case.
- Validation registry with reviewer-facing gates, tolerances, citations, and reports.
- Continuum and convergence artifact plotting:
  - `fax plot-continuum`
  - `fax plot-convergence`
- README and ReadTheDocs figures generated from public workflows and checked for nonblank rendering.
- Auto-updating README badges for CI, docs, publish, coverage, PyPI, Python versions, license, Ruff, and JAX.
- Research examples for validation packets, sensitivity analysis, toy inverse design, a basic BAE/TAE/EAE gap map, reduced global/gap/fast-ion screening, Boozer harmonic validation, real `boozmn` local 3-D continuum plotting, and real `boozmn` global radial 3-D eigenmode plotting.

## Important Scope Note

v0.0.1 is not yet a publication-grade full 3-D stellarator Alfvén-eigenmode
solver. It is the tested scaffold for the first paper-quality milestones:
operator validation, differentiability, convergence reporting, VMEC/Boozer
adapter hardening, and cross-code comparison gates.
The current local gates include STELLGAP CTOK local-continuum/gap parity,
STELLGAP executable status capture, and AE3D public matrix/mode-shape parity.
These do not yet claim native FAX-vs-AE3D/CAS3D/FAR3D full-operator parity;
that remains the next validation lane.

## Local Validation

The release candidate was validated locally because GitHub Actions are
temporarily unavailable:

```bash
python tools/generate_validation_figures.py
python tools/qa_figures.py
python -m ruff check .
python -m mypy src/fax
python -m coverage run --source=src/fax -m pytest
python -m coverage report --fail-under=95
sphinx-build -W -b html docs docs/_build/html
python -m build
python -m twine check dist/*
```

## PyPI

The repository publish workflow uses PyPI trusted publishing through
`pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish`. Publishing is triggered when this GitHub release
is published, or manually through the `Publish` workflow.

The PyPI distribution name is `uwplasma-fax`; the import package and CLI remain
`fax`.
